subject: Request: short demo bridge while PO routes through reseller onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@neptunelabs.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-19T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Need to keep pilot live — PO stuck during reseller onboarding

Marissa,

Quick note — our procurement team routed Neptune's purchase order through a new reseller (ProcureOne) to meet internal vendor policies. That onboarding is taking longer than expected (they flagged a W9 + SLA review). We were supposed to finalize payment today but the PO is stuck in vendor onboarding and our dev team needs the preview environment for next week's stakeholder demo.

Can Redwood keep the sandbox live for another full week and provide a small credits top-up (~5k token equivalent) so we don't lose momentum? We can share the provisional PO number and the reseller contact for verification.

I appreciate any urgent help here — demo is scheduled for 2028-05-26 and losing the environment would push timelines out significantly.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu
Product Lead, Neptune Labs
alex.wu@neptunelabs.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

---
Attachment: PO-provisional-20280518.pdf (stub, 1 page)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@neptunelabs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to keep pilot live — PO stuck during reseller onboarding

Alex — thanks for the context and for flagging the reseller route.

We can absolutely help preserve the demo momentum. I can provision a 7-day bridge on the sandbox and add a 10k token credit to cover the stakeholder sessions — pending a quick approvals note from our finance team. To move quickly I need both:

- The provisional PO number and reseller contact (ProcureOne rep) for our records
- Confirmation you'll accept a short trial extension addendum (I attached standard trial-extension-terms)

If you confirm here, I'll loop in finance for a rapid approval and aim to have the bridge applied within 48 hours. We try to minimize recurring waivers, so this will be recorded as a one-time courtesy tied to the pending PO number.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: trial-extension-terms.pdf (stub, 2 pages)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@neptunelabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request — 7-day sandbox bridge + 10k tokens for Neptune Labs (DEAL-9421)

Kimberly / Rishi —

Neptune Labs (DEAL-9421) routed their PO through ProcureOne; onboarding is delayed by vendor paperwork (W9, SLA review). Customer is asking to keep the sandbox live for the stakeholder demo on 05/26. I proposed a one-time 7-day bridge and 10k token credit to preserve momentum.

Key items:
- Customer: Neptune Labs (Alex Wu)
- PO status: provisional PO routed to ProcureOne; expected to clear in 4–6 business days per Alex
- Commercial ask: 7-day extension + 10k token credit applied to their sandbox environment
- Risk: low; they provided provisional PO and are a standard ARR opportunity
- Compliance: they signed the trial-extension addendum (attached)

Can we approve this as a one-off courtesy and have billing apply the credit? If you want, I can limit the credit to the sandbox project id for audit. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9421. DocuSign addendum is here: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/embedded/DEAL-9421

Quick approvals or a short reply are fine — Alex is waiting and wants to lock the demo logistics.

Thanks,
Marissa

> On 2028-05-19, Alex Wu wrote:
> > Our procurement team routed Neptune's purchase order through a new reseller (ProcureOne) to meet internal vendor policies. That onboarding is taking longer than expected...

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@neptunelabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request — 7-day sandbox bridge + 10k tokens for Neptune Labs (DEAL-9421)

Marissa — approved.

Notes for audit: one-time courtesy credit (10,000 tokens) applied to Neptune Labs sandbox project id NL-9421-SBX. Extension window: 2028-05-22 11:00 PDT through 2028-05-29 11:00 PDT. Condition: customer provided provisional PO #PO-8073 and ProcureOne contact (diane@procureone.com).

Rishi — please confirm billing applied the token credit and tag the entry to DEAL-9421. Alex — we've applied the bridge and the environment will remain live through 05/29. If anything changes on the PO timing, let us know and we'll reassess.

Kimberly Park
Finance Manager, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
